brief.oneLiner: AOL mobile app for browsing curated news feeds, reading articles, viewing comments, and managing personal account feeds.
brief.audience: General news readers and AOL account holders looking for categorized news, entertainment, and local updates.
coreLoop: Browse news headlines and categories on the home feed
Tap an article to view details and full content
Read or interact with article comments and discussions
Save or share articles of interest
brief.howItMakesMoney: Monetizes primarily through native and display advertisements (such as Taboola advertising units) embedded within news feeds and article pages.
brief.adsToday: Banner and native sponsored recommendations (Taboola) appear frequently throughout the news feed and article view pages.
openQuestions: Are there paid subscription tiers for ad-free news reading hidden behind account sign-in walls?
What additional features unlock upon signing into an AOL account?

flowNames.name: Read Article and Comment Flow
flowNames.goal: Engage the user by letting them read full news content, view comments, and attempt to post a comment.

flowNames.name: Entertainment Category Exploration
flowNames.goal: Allow users to switch to the Entertainment category feed to browse entertainment news.

flowNames.name: Local News Exploration
flowNames.goal: Allow users to check local headlines and weather information.

flowNames.name: Sports and General News Feed Navigation
flowNames.goal: Enable users to switch between sports news, business, politics, and general news feeds.

extraMoments.description: User attempts to post a comment on an article and hits the sign-up wall.
User opens the sidebar menu to access account settings, saved articles, contacts, and support.
